key_points: Positive topline Phase 3 results for dazodalibep in systemic Sjögren’s disease met primary endpoint.
Amgen shares rose ~1.3% on the news, with GF Score 87 highlighting strength.
Analysts see new autoimmune pipeline opportunity; stock up ~15.5% past 90 days.
Some warnings about acquisition debt, legacy drug erosion, and obesity bet cash demands.
Dividend increase announced but may be constrained by competing cash needs.
